exposure: Estimated blood loss at IUBT use
outcome: Need for additional invasive procedures (uterine embolization or surgical procedure)
cohort: 238 women who underwent IUBT for severe postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) after vaginal or cesarean delivery between 2012 and 2021 at a hospital in Lille, France
finding: The study found that while the overall success rate of IUBT was 78%, predictors of IUBT failure could only be identified in the vaginal delivery group, where coagulopathies and higher estimated blood loss at IUBT use were significantly associated with failure.
mod_finding: Predictors of IUBT failure were only identifiable in the vaginal delivery group: coagulopathies and higher estimated blood loss at IUBT use were associated with IUBT failure, while no predictors were found in the cesarean delivery group.
